intro: Ben Jam's journey began in Essex, England, in 1989, DJing early House and Hardcore Breakbeat under the name Chill'm. After building a reputation through local events and pirate radio, he moved to London in 1995, becoming a respected figure on the House circuit with residencies at Favouritizm, Summerhouse, FunkShoppe, Fling, Po Na Na and a legendary six-year stint at Detroit Bar. He has played many of London's iconic venues, including Turnmills, Heaven, Herbal and Plan B, and co-hosted Favouritizm Live on Trust The DJ Radio. Now based in Perth, Western Australia, Ben combines over three decades of DJ experience with a passion for music production. As a producer and founder of Brain Kat Records, he has released original tracks and remixes spanning House, Jackin', Deep and Tech House, championing underground electronic music and supporting emerging artists worldwide.

sections.heading: London Years
paragraphs: Cutting his teeth through the '90s and early 2000s, Ben Jam held down residencies across some of London's most storied rooms and spaces, including a 6 year residency on Friday night at Detroit Bar in Covent Garden.  He founded multiple events including Fling, Summerhouse, Real Fruit, and in 2000 joined F@vouritizm with Sarah Foote.  In 2001 they were invited to host "Favouritizm Live" on www.trustthedj.co.uk. During this period, Ben worked for Intermedia, a National TV & Radio music promotion company, based at Gut Records HQ in Maida Vale, London. Looking after some of the worlds biggest artists and releases. He also worked on some of the biggest UK festivals, managing the media interest and artist interviews.

sections.heading: Perth, Australia
paragraphs: In 2004 Ben Jam relocated to Perth, Western Australia, where he continued to hold down residencies with Democracy & Soul Project through the late 2000s and early 2010s, alongside guest sets including Hed Kandi's 2011 New Year's Eve party with Joey Negro.
It's also where Brain Kat Records was born — a home for his own productions as well as a small roster of house, disco and bass-leaning artists.
